rules: terminal-ui consumes only immutable presentation nodes and typed interaction state
terminal-ui never consumes raw SessionEvent, transport frames, API clients or control metadata
one Ink React tree owns transcript, BottomPane and status zones
the shared shell descriptor contract lives in contracts/tui/terminal-ui/terminal-shell.types.ts
optional appContainer.chromeNodes use the shared closed TuiChromeRenderNode contract
app-container produces chromeNodes; terminal-lifecycle renders them only through generic placement and style fields
terminal-ui and terminal-lifecycle import the same shell descriptor; no duplicated DTO may exist
transcript cells preserve nodeId and publicationRevision while streaming
follow-tail stops on explicit scroll and reflow preserves the node anchor
component lookup is exact; missing renderer is an explicit error
child components emit typed terminal intents and never call Host APIs
Ink is the only terminal carrier and terminal-lifecycle is the only render-instance owner
